verses.pali: “Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, anāsevitaṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati anāsevitā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, those who haven’t cultivated mindfulness of the body haven’t cultivated freedom from death.

verses.pali: Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, āsevitaṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati āsevitā”ti.
verses.english: Those who have cultivated mindfulness of the body have cultivated freedom from death.”
